pages.ja:
そうして彼女
遠坂凛は目的の場所に到着した。
間桐邸。
二百年前この町に移り住んできた、古い魔術師の家系の工房。
協力者としてこの土地を譲ったものの、決して交友を持たなかった異分子たる同朋。
遠坂と間桐は互いに不可侵であり、無闇に関わってはならぬと盟約によって縛られている。

pages.en:
And so she—Rin Tohsaka—arrives at her destination.

The Matou residence.

The workshop of an ancient lineage of mages who settled in this city two hundred years ago.

Fellow outsiders, granted this land in a spirit of cooperation, with whom the Tohsakas nevertheless never once consorted.

The Tohsaka and Matou families are bound by a covenant of mutual noninterference, forbidden to intrude lightly in one another's affairs.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And the girlTohsaka Rin reaches her destination.
The Matou household.
The workshop of the old family of magi who came to this town two hundred years ago.
Even though her family gave them land as a cooperator, the Matou family are outsiders they never concerned themselves with.
The two families formed a non-aggression pact, and bound themselves to not be concerned with each other’s affairs.

pages.ja:
「
」
それがどうした、と彼女は歩を進めた。
互いに関わってはならないのが盟約ならば、そんなモノは十一年前に破られている。
だいたい盟約を取りかわした者は遥か昔の当主たちだ。
その内容も、理由すらも定かではない決まり事に従うこと二百年。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」

その内容も、理由すらも定かではない決まり事に従うこと二百年。
pages.en:
“——”

So what? She presses onward.

If their covenant forbids them from interfering with one another, then it was broken eleven years ago.

Besides, the people who made it were heads of the two families long since dead.

For two hundred years, both houses have obeyed a rule whose terms—and even whose purpose—are now uncertain.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
She walks on, uncaring.
If there was a pact forbidding the two families to associate, it was broken eleven years ago.
It was originally formed by the heads of the two families.
They had abided by it for two hundred years, though its purpose had been forgotten.

pages.ja:
その間、遠坂も間桐も目的である聖杯を手に入れていない。
もとより両家の盟約は、“聖杯”を手に入れる事のみで固められたもの。
それが今まで叶わなかった以上、こんな古臭い決まりに従う道理はない。
pages.jaRuby:
その間、遠坂も間桐も目的である聖杯を手に入れていない。
もとより両家の盟約は、“聖杯”を手に入れる事のみで固められたもの。
それが今まで叶わなかった以上、こんな古臭い決まりに従う道理はない。
pages.en:
In all that time, neither Tohsaka nor Matou has obtained the Holy Grail they sought.

From the beginning, the covenant between their houses was founded solely on the pursuit of the “Holy Grail.”

Since that purpose remains unfulfilled, she has no reason to honor so antiquated a rule.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Neither Tohsaka nor Matou have obtained the Holy Grail during that time.
Their pact was made to obtain the Holy Grail.
But since their wish never came true, there is no reason to follow such an ancient pact now.

pages.ja:
呼び鈴も押さず、玄関から押し入る。
彼女は客として来訪したのではない。
あくまで一人のマスターとして、聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに来たにすぎない。
pages.jaRuby:
呼び鈴も押さず、玄関から押し入る。
彼女は客として来訪したのではない。
あくまで一人のマスターとして、聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに来たにすぎない。
pages.en:
Without so much as ringing the bell, she forces her way through the front door.

She has not come as a guest.

She has come strictly as a Master, to eliminate an outsider who has defiled the Holy Grail War.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She strides through the front door without ringing the doorbell.
She did not come here as a guest.
She is here as a Master, to eliminate one of her competitors in this game.

pages.ja:
「……そう、なんだけどさ」
苦虫を噛み潰す表情で、凛は間桐邸を探索していく。
……来訪の原因は聖杯戦争によるものだ。
故に遠坂と間桐の盟約に縛られる必要はない。
そう自分に言い聞かせたものの、長年培った体質は変わらない。
pages.jaRuby:
「……そう、なんだけどさ」
苦虫を噛み潰す表情で、凛は間桐邸を探索していく。

pages.en:
“…That's true, but still.”

Rin searches the Matou residence with the expression of someone chewing bitter gall.

…The Holy Grail War is what brought her here.

Therefore, the covenant between Tohsaka and Matou has no claim on her.

She tells herself as much, but a lifetime's conditioning is not so easily undone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, that’s true, but…”
Rin searches through the Matou household with a sour expression.
…The Holy Grail War provided her with the reason to come here.
Therefore, she is not bound by the pact between their families.
Even though she persuades herself, she cannot change her personality.

pages.ja:
「……そっか。父さんの言いつけを破ったのって、これが初めてなんだ」
ぼんやりと呟く。
別段、それはどうという事ではなかった。
父の教えを破った事で、大切な何かが壊れた訳でもないのだから。
pages.jaRuby:
「……そっか。父さんの言いつけを破ったのって、これが初めてなんだ」
ぼんやりと呟く。
別段、それはどうという事ではなかった。
父の教えを破った事で、大切な何かが壊れた訳でもないのだから。
pages.en:
“…I see. This is the first time I've ever disobeyed Father.”

She murmurs it absently.

The fact itself is nothing of consequence.

Defying her father's teachings has not caused anything precious within her to break.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I see. This is the first time I’ve gone against my dad’s instruction.”
She mutters to herself.
But it’s nothing special.
It’s not like something important was destroyed by disobeying her father.

pages.ja:
ただ、悔いる事があるとすれば、それは
「……馬鹿ね。どうせ破るのなら、もっと早くに押しかければ良かったのに」
十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった。
pages.jaRuby:
ただ、悔いる事があるとすれば、それは
「……馬鹿ね。どうせ破るのなら、もっと早くに押しかければ良かったのに」
十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった。
pages.en:
If she has any regret, it is only this—

“…Idiot. If I was going to break it anyway, I should have barged in much sooner.”

A regret for someone else, nursed for more than a decade.
pages.mirrorMoon:
If she regrets anything…
“…How stupid of me. I should’ve came here earlier if I was going to break the pact anyway.”
…It’s the remorse towards someone who has endured it for over ten years.

pages.ja:
「
凛。屋敷の間取りだが、空白部分が二つある」
「え？ どこよそれ、一階？」
「二階からだ。階段にしては狭いが、おそらく地下に通じている」
「……オーケー。ところでアーチャー、気付いてる？」
「当然だ。だが害はあるまい。凛が無視するかぎりは私も気にかけん。我々の目的はあの臓硯だからな」
傍らの声に頷いて、彼女は二階の隠し通路へ移動する。
pages.jaRuby:
「

傍らの声に頷いて、彼女は二階の隠し通路へ移動する。
pages.en:
“—Rin. There are two gaps in the mansion's floor plan.”

“What? Where? On the first floor?”

“It starts on the second floor. It is too narrow to be a staircase, but most likely leads underground.”

“…Okay. By the way, Archer. You've noticed it, haven't you?”

“Naturally. But it should pose no danger. So long as you ignore it, I shall do the same. Our objective is that monster Zouken.”

Nodding to the voice beside her, she heads for the hidden passage on the second floor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Rin. It’s about the layout of the house. There are two blank areas.”
“Huh? Where is that? Is it on the first floor?”
“The second. It’s a bit small to be a stairway, but it probably goes down to the basement.”
“…Okay. By the way, have you noticed it, Archer?”
“Of course. But it shouldn’t be harmful. If you choose to ignore it, I will as well. Our target is that monster.”
She nods to his words and goes to the second floor.

pages.ja:
姿こそ見えないが、凛には赤い騎士が付き従っている。
戦闘に備えて連れてきたのだが、彼女のサーヴァントは細かい事に気が回る性質のようだ。
屋敷を一回りしただけで設計図を思い描き、本来なければおかしい部屋がない事を指摘する。
凛も薄々気がついてはいたが、アーチャーは物の設計、構造を把握する能力に、騎士とは思えないほど特化しているらしい。
pages.jaRuby:
姿こそ見えないが、凛には赤い騎士が付き従っている。

凛も薄々気がついてはいたが、アーチャーは物の設計、構造を把握する能力に、騎士とは思えないほど特化しているらしい。
pages.en:
—Though unseen, the red knight is at Rin's side.

She brought him in case there was a fight, but her Servant appears to have an eye for detail as well.

One circuit of the mansion was enough for him to reconstruct its design in his mind and identify the missing spaces—the rooms whose absence made no architectural sense.

Rin had begun to suspect as much herself, but Archer's grasp of design and structure is developed to a degree one would hardly expect of a knight.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Even though the red knight is not visible, he is by her side.
She brought him in case of combat, but it seems he takes notice of small details.
After traversing the house once, he has come up with a blueprint and can point out where the empty spaces are.
Rin has come to realize that Archer is skilled in analyzing the design and structure of objects.

pages.ja:
「……前から思ってたけど。貴方のそれって、弓の騎士としてどうかと思う長所よね」
「減らず口はあとだ。そら、開いたぞ。暗いから気をつけ
」
会話が止まる。
開けた壁。
ぱっくりと口をあけた地下への通路から、湿った空気が漏れてくる。
それは実体化していないアーチャーにも感じ取れるほど、耐えがたい腐臭だった。
pages.jaRuby:
「……前から思ってたけど。貴方のそれって、[ruby text=アーチャー char=4]弓の騎士としてどうかと思う長所よね」

」

pages.en:
“…I've thought this for some time, but for an Archer, that is an awfully peculiar talent.”

“Save your wit for later. There, it is open. Take care—it is dark—”

Their conversation dies.

The wall has opened.

Damp air seeps from the passageway gaping down into the earth.

The stench of putrefaction is so unbearable that even the dematerialized Archer can perceive it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I’ve been thinking. That strong point of yours isn’t suited for an archer.”
“You can whine later. Here, I got it open. It’s dark, so watch”
They stop talking.
From the opening in the wall…
Damp air flows out of the pathway to the basement.
The rotten smell is unbearable even for Archer, who has not taken form.

pages.ja:
湿った石畳に下りる。
周囲は緑色の闇だった。
無数に開いた穴は死者を埋葬する為の物だろう。
石の棺に納められた遺体は腐り、風化し、穴はがらんどうのまま、次なる亡骸を求めている。
その有り方は地上の埋葬と酷似している。
ただ、その腐り落ちる過程が決定的に異なるだけだ。
ここでは遺体を分解する役割は土ではなく、無数に蠢く蟲たちに与えられていた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
She descends onto wet flagstones.

Green darkness surrounds her.

The countless niches must have been made to bury the dead.

The bodies laid in stone coffins have rotted and weathered away, leaving the hollows vacant, waiting for the next corpses to come.

In that respect, it resembles burial aboveground.

Only the process of decay is fundamentally different.

Here, it is not earth that breaks the bodies down. That task has been given to the innumerable worms writhing all around her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
They come down to a damp, stone paving.
Murky greenish darkness engulfs them.
The numerous holes must be to bury dead people.
In these stone chambers, the corpses decompose and fade away, leaving the holes empty to await their next occupant.
It is like the process of burial above ground.
The only difference is the process of decomposition.
It is not the soil that decomposes the corpse here, but the writhing mass of worms.

pages.ja:
「ここが間桐
マキリの修練場
」
呟いて、目眩がした。
嫌悪や悪寒からではない。
彼女を戦慄させ、後悔させ、嘔吐させたのは怒りだった。
これが修練場。
こんなものが修練場。
この、腐った水気と立ち込める死臭と有象無象の蠢く蟲たちしかいない空間が、間桐の後継者に与えられた“部屋”だった。
pages.jaRuby:
「ここが間桐

」

pages.en:
“So this is the Matou—the Makiri training chamber—”

She whispers the words, and vertigo takes her.

It is neither revulsion nor dread.

What makes her tremble, what fills her with regret, what turns her stomach until she vomits—is rage.

This is a training chamber.

This is what they call a training chamber.

This room, empty but for stagnant moisture, the choking reek of death, and a nameless multitude of crawling worms, was the “room” bestowed on the heir to the Matou family.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“This is the training ground of the Matouthe Makiri”
She gets dizzy.
It’s not because of disgust or chill.
It is anger that causes her to shudder, repent, and vomit.
This is the training ground.
A place like this is used as a training ground.
This space containing rotten moisture, the smell of corpses, and infinite worms is the “room” given to the successor of the Matou family.

pages.ja:
「
っ」
こんなもの
こんな所で何を学ぶというのか。
ここにあるのは、ただ飼育するものだけだ。
蟲を飼う。蟲を増やす。蟲を鍛える。
それと同じように、間桐の人間はこの蟲たちによって後継ぎを仕込み、後継ぎを鞭打ち、後継ぎを飼育して

っ」

pages.en:
“————”

What—what could anyone possibly learn in a place like this?

Nothing here is taught. Things are merely reared.

Raise the worms. Multiply the worms. Temper the worms.

And in the same fashion, the Matous have those worms prepare their heir, scourge their heir, breed their heir—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
What can one learn in such a place?
The only thing here is breeding stock.
Worms to breed. Worms to raise. Worms to train.
The people of Matou have trained, urged, and bred their successor with these worms

pages.ja: それは、自分とどれほど異なる世界だったのか。
pages.jaRuby: それは、自分とどれほど異なる世界だったのか。
pages.en: —How utterly different a world had this been from her own?
pages.mirrorMoon: How different is this world from her own?

pages.ja:
冷徹な教え、課題の困難さ、刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み。
そういった“後継者”としての厳しさを比べているのではない。
そも、背負った苦悩、越えねばならなかった壁で言うのなら、彼女が乗り越えてきた障害とて他に類を見ない。
乗り越えてきた厳しさと困難さでは、間違いなく遠坂凛に分があるだろう。
それ故の五大元素使い、魔術協会が特待生として迎え入れようとするほどの若き魔術師だ。
pages.jaRuby:
冷徹な教え、課題の困難さ、刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み。

そも、背負った苦悩、越えねばならなかった壁で言うのなら、彼女が乗り越えてきた障害とて他に類を見ない。
乗り越えてきた厳しさと困難さでは、間違いなく遠坂凛に分があるだろう。
それ故の[ruby text=アベレージ・ワン char=6]五大元素使い、魔術協会が特待生として迎え入れようとするほどの若き[ruby text=てんさい char=3]魔術師だ。
pages.en:
The cold severity of her lessons. The difficulty of her assignments. The pain of the Magic Crest carved into her.

She is not comparing the hardships they endured as successors.

Indeed, if one speaks of burdens borne and walls overcome, the trials she herself has conquered are nearly without equal.

In sheer severity and difficulty, Rin Tohsaka's path was unquestionably the greater.

That is why she commands all five elements in perfect balance—an Average One—and why, though still so young, she is already a prodigy among mages, one the Mage's Association would welcome as a special student.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The cold-hearted ways, the difficulty of the tasks, and the pain of the engraved Magic Circuit.
She’s not comparing the severity as the successor.
If one is to talk about the burdened sufferings and the harshness, hers is incomparable.
She overcame more difficulties and hardships than anyone.
That is why she is a genius magus and an Average One, the user of the five elements, that the Magic Association is accepting as a scholarship student.

pages.ja:
この部屋に巣食う蟲どもを統率しろ、と言われれば、彼女なら半年でより優れた術式を組み上げられる。
間桐の後継者が十年かけてまだ習得できない魔術を、凛ならば半年で書き換える事ができるのだ。
pages.jaRuby:
この部屋に巣食う蟲どもを統率しろ、と言われれば、彼女なら半年でより優れた術式を組み上げられる。
間桐の後継者が十年かけてまだ習得できない魔術を、凛ならば半年で書き換える事ができるのだ。
pages.en:
Had she been told to take command of the worms infesting this chamber, she could have constructed a superior system of magecraft within six months.

The magecraft the Matou heir had failed to master in ten years, Rin could have rewritten in half a year.
pages.mirrorMoon:
If one orders her to command the worms in this room, she will be able to create a superior spell in half a year.
Rin can create a spell that the successor of the Matou family has been unable to create even after ten years.

pages.ja:
だが
その愚鈍な学習方法。
術者を蟲どもへの慰みものにするという方式に耐えられたかと問われれば、彼女は言葉を飲むしかない。
pages.jaRuby:
だが
その愚鈍な学習方法。
術者を蟲どもへの慰みものにするという方式に耐えられたかと問われれば、彼女は言葉を飲むしかない。
pages.en:
But—this brutish method of instruction.

If asked whether she could have endured a system that made the practitioner a plaything for the worms, even she can only swallow her answer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Butthis method of learning is madness.
If asked whether she could withstand being violated by these worms, she can only hesitate.

pages.ja:
ここで行われる魔術の継承は、学習ではなく拷問だ。
頭脳ではなく肉体そのものに直接教え込む魔術。
それがマキリの継承法であり、間桐臓硯という老魔術師の嗜好なのだ。
故に。
間桐の後継者に選ばれるという事は、終わりのない責め苦を負わされるという事である

pages.en:
The inheritance of magecraft practiced here is not education. It is torture.

Magecraft driven directly into the flesh rather than taught to the mind.

That is the Makiri method of succession. That is the predilection of the ancient mage called Zouken Matou.

Therefore—

To be chosen as the Matou heir is to be condemned to torment without end—
pages.mirrorMoon:

A magic that is taught not to the mind, but to the body.
That is how the Makiris pass on their magic, and this is the preference of the old magus, Matou Zouken.
Therefore…
To be chosen as the successor of the Matou family means to be tortured forever

The girl's footsteps recede.

“Am I wrong? Though you were born into the Matou family, you had no Magic Circuits. But that was not your fault. The Matou blood had already grown thin. From the moment they took root in this land, the Matous' duty as seekers had begun to fade.

“And yet you clung to it.

“You mistook distinction for worth and coveted what you never needed simply because you lacked it. Even gaining Magic Circuits that way would never have made you a mage, yet still you groveled after the ‘privilege that should have been yours.’”
pages.mirrorMoon:

But you persisted.
You thought it was special to be special, and you demanded something you didn’t need. You can’t be a magus even if you obtained a Magic Circuit like that, but you clung to the special right that should’ve been given to you.”

その、偏執しきった視線を前にして、遠坂凛ははあ、と両肩で嘆息した。
pages.jaRuby:
衛宮士郎への憎悪が恐怖を打ち消したのか、間桐慎二は真正面から遠坂凛を凝視する。
その、偏執しきった視線を前にして、遠坂凛ははあ、と両肩で嘆息した。
pages.en:
Perhaps his hatred for Shirou Emiya overcomes his fear, for Shinji Matou now stares Rin Tohsaka squarely in the eye.

Faced with that thoroughly deranged gaze, Rin heaves a sigh, her shoulders rising and falling.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Shinji’s hatred for Shirou must have blown his fears away, as he now faces Rin straight on.
The girl sighs and shrugs her shoulders.

pages.ja: 「……そう。これだけ言っても判らないようじゃ本当に処置なしね。少しは責任を取らせようと思ったけど、貴方にはその価値さえない。ここで見逃してあげるから、衛宮くんにやられる前に教会にでも逃げ込みなさい」
pages.jaRuby: 「……そう。これだけ言っても判らないようじゃ本当に処置なしね。少しは責任を取らせようと思ったけど、貴方にはその価値さえない。ここで見逃してあげるから、衛宮くんにやられる前に教会にでも逃げ込みなさい」
pages.en: “…I see. If you still can't understand after all that, then you really are beyond help. I thought I might make you answer for some of this, but you aren't even worth that much. I'll let you go this time, so flee to the church or somewhere before Emiya gets to you.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “……I see. I guess you really are beyond help if you don’t understand after all this. I thought I’d hold you responsible, but you’re not even worth it. I’ll let you go, so go run to the church before Emiya-kun beats you.”

pages.ja:
瞳を苛立たせたまま、遠坂凛は間桐慎二に背を向けた。
もうここに用はない、と。
間桐慎二というマスターを敵とすら見ず、彼女は間桐邸を後にする。

pages.en:
Irritation still burning in her eyes, Rin Tohsaka turns her back on Shinji Matou.

There is nothing more for her here.

She does not even regard the Master called Shinji Matou as an enemy. She simply leaves the Matou residence behind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She turns her back on him.
Telling him she has no business here.
She heads for the door, not even bothering to treat Shinji as an enemy.

pages.ja:
「僕が
衛宮に劣る、だって……？」
繰り返す言葉には憎悪しかなかった。
だが、間桐慎二は壁に張り付いたまま、去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない。
ここで襲いかかれば、確実に殺される。
その事実、その力関係だけは、間桐慎二でさえ感じ取れていたからだ。

pages.en:
“You think I'm—inferior to Emiya…?”

There is nothing in the repeated words but hatred.

Yet Shinji Matou remains pinned against the wall, able only to watch Rin Tohsaka walk away.

If he attacked her here, she would kill him without fail.

Even Shinji Matou can grasp that simple fact—that balance of power.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“II’m inferior to Emiya…?”
His voice burns with hatred.
But he can do nothing but watch her go.
He’ll surely be killed if he attacks her here.
Even Matou Shinji can see the difference in their powers.

pages.ja:
「遠坂
おまえ、おまえ…………！」
際限のない怨嗟の声。
「
もう、しょうがないな」
それに彼女は足を止め、振り向かずに間桐の後継ぎだった少年に別れを告げる。
pages.jaRuby:
「遠坂
おまえ、おまえ…………！」

もう、しょうがないな」

pages.en:
“Tohsaka—you… you…………!”

His voice seethes with bottomless resentment.

“—Oh, fine.”

At that, she stops. Without looking back, she bids farewell to the boy who was once the Matou heir.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsakayou, you……!”
A voice filled with deep resentment.
“Geez, I guess it can’t be helped.”
She stops, and says goodbye to the boy that used to be the successor.

pages.ja:
「いいわ、最後に教えてあげる。
自分以外の為に先を目指すもの。自己よりも他者を顧みるもの。……そして、誰よりも自分を嫌いなもの。
これが魔術師としての素質ってヤツよ。どんなに魔術回路があったところで、ソレがない者には到達できない所がある。
……ふん。わたしだって、そんな条件を満たしているヤツがいるなんて思ってもみなかった。こればっかりは、生まれつき壊れてないと持てない矛盾だから」

pages.en:
“Fine. I'll tell you one last thing.

“One who strives beyond himself for someone else. One who values others above himself. …And one who hates himself more than anyone.

“Those are the makings of a mage. However richly endowed with Magic Circuits, however talented, there are heights you can never reach without them.

“…Hmph. I never imagined anyone could satisfy those conditions either. It is a contradiction found only in someone born broken.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Fine, this is the end, so I’ll tell you.
Those who aim farther for others’ sake. Those who think of others before themselves. …And those who hate themselves more than anyone.
These are the qualities of a magus. There is a place you can’t reach, no matter how much talent you have.
…Humph. I never thought anyone would meet this condition. This is a contradiction you can only have if you’re born broken.”

pages.ja:
「慎二。アンタは他人を蔑む事で、同時に抱かなくてもいい劣等感を抱いた典型よ。自分が好きなあまり周りを下に見たものの、見下す相手が上にいるものだから、つまらない劣等感に囚われただけ。
……貴方の中身は空っぽよ。詰まっているように思えるのは本人だけで、正体は風船と一緒。まわりの風向き次第で、行き着く先なんてくるくる変わる」
「ぅ
、ぐ」

「ぅ
、ぐ」
pages.en:
“Shinji. You are a textbook case: by scorning everyone around you, you burdened yourself with an inferiority complex you never needed. You loved yourself so much that you looked down on others, only to find the people beneath you standing higher than you were. And so you became a prisoner to that petty sense of inferiority.

“…There is nothing inside you. You alone mistake yourself for full, but in truth you are a balloon. The direction of the wind around you is all it takes to send you drifting toward a different end.”

“Ngh——gh.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shinji. You’re a good example of someone who nurtures a needless inferiority complex by despising others. You love yourself so much that you believe everyone else is below you, even when they are superior in every way.
…You’re empty inside. The only one who thinks you’re full is you, and you’re just like a balloon. Your destination changes depending on the wind.”
“Uhguh.”

pages.ja:
「理解した？ そんな男に魔術師なんて務まらないし、サーヴァントだって従わないわ。
ここから先は貴方には関係のない世界よ。間桐慎二がどんなに自分をマスターだと言い張っても、貴方は絶対にマスターにはなれないんだから」
pages.jaRuby:
「理解した？ そんな男に魔術師なんて務まらないし、サーヴァントだって従わないわ。
ここから先は貴方には関係のない世界よ。間桐慎二がどんなに自分をマスターだと言い張っても、貴方は絶対にマスターにはなれないんだから」
pages.en:
“Do you understand now? A man like that could never make it as a mage, and no Servant would obey him.

“The world beyond this point has nothing to do with you. No matter how insistently Shinji Matou calls himself a Master, you will never become one.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Do you understand? One such as you is unfit to be a magus. A Servant would never obey such a person.
This world is unrelated to you. No matter how much you consider yourself to be a Master, you can never be a Master.”

pages.ja:
去っていく足音。
遠坂凛は一度も振り返らず、間桐慎二を暗い部屋に残していった。
pages.jaRuby:
去っていく足音。
遠坂凛は一度も振り返らず、間桐慎二を暗い部屋に残していった。
pages.en:
—Her footsteps recede.

Rin Tohsaka never looks back. She leaves Shinji Matou alone in the darkened room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The sound of retreating footsteps.
Tohsaka Rin leaves Matou Shinji alone in the dark room.

pages.ja:
「
は。はは、ははは」
ずるり、と壁から落ちる。
間桐慎二は糸の切れた人形のように床に崩れ落ち、ひきつった顔で笑い続ける。
pages.jaRuby:
「
は。はは、ははは」
ずるり、と壁から落ちる。
間桐慎二は糸の切れた人形のように床に崩れ落ち、ひきつった顔で笑い続ける。
pages.en:
“—Ha. Hah, hahahaha.”

He slides down the wall.

Like a puppet with severed strings, Shinji Matou crumples to the floor and continues laughing through a contorted face.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha. Haha, hahaha.”
He drops down the wall.
Matou Shinji crumples down like a puppet with its strings cut and keeps laughing.

pages.ja:
「なんだ。そうか、そういうことか」
唾液にまみれた舌が、乾いた唇を舐め上げる。
ガツン、という音。
少年は乱暴に、骨を砕くかの勢いで壁に後頭部を打ち付け、
「
ようするにさ。
あいつがいなくなればいいって言うんだろ、遠坂？」
くつくつと、空っぽの哄笑を上げ続けた。

pages.en:
“Oh. I see. So that's what it is.”

His saliva-slick tongue passes over dry lips.

A heavy thud.

The boy slams the back of his head violently against the wall, with enough force to shatter bone.

“—What you're saying is…

“Everything will be fine once he's gone. Isn't that right, Tohsaka?”

His hollow laughter goes on and on.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. So that’s how it is?”
His tongue licks over dry lips.
A dull sound.
The boy smacks his head hard against the wall behind him, as if trying to break his skull.
“In short…
He just has to disappear, right, Tohsaka?”
His laughter continues.
